text:
amanda: Quick sync — we keep getting SDK drift on error surface. Proposal: single canonical shape that is compact by default and verbose opt-in. Thoughts?
priya: +1. Keys I care about: code (namespaced), status (int), user_message (friendly), message (internal), retryable (bool), retry_after (secs|null), retry_hint, user_action (string).
jason: SDKs should map into typed exceptions (e.g., AuthTokenExpired) with properties for user_message/retry_hint/docs_url. Also add a `.shouldRetry()` helper that obeys `retryable` when present, otherwise falls back to HTTP mapping.
lucas: Agree on explicit `retryable` to avoid guesswork. Mapping rules: 429 -> retryable=true unless explicitly false; 5xx -> retryable=true; 4xx -> retryable=false unless retry_hint or retryable=true.
emily: Sample apps: show `user_message` in banner, keep a small "details" expander that reveals `message` only when client requests verbose (header X-Error-Detail: verbose). Keep user_message <140 chars for mobile.
amanda: Example verbose payload for docs (as inline example): { error: { code: "auth.token_expired", status: 401, message: "token expired at verifier", user_message: "Your session expired. Please sign in.", user_action: "refresh_token", retryable: false, retry_after: null, retry_hint: "refresh_token", meta: "docs:/errors#auth.token_expired" } }
priya: I'll open API PR to add `user_message`,`user_action`,`retryable`, and header support for compact|verbose. Will add canonical examples for SDK tests.
jason: SDK leads — add parity tests that assert typed exception class, fields present, and `.shouldRetry()` behavior.
ci-bot: CI: sample-apps/test-suite  failed on sdk-go parity test — https://ci.redwood.internal/4242
lucas: I'll take the failing Go test. Likely interpreting 401 as retryable in one branch.
amanda: Goal: land API change + docs this week; SDK parity tests next sprint. Keep updates here.
